sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Air Freight Forwarding and Cargo Aircraft Charter

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Spanish-Napoleonic codified tradition) supplemented by a modern Commercial Code; Private Interest Foundations regulated by special statute (Law 25 of 1995) with Anglo-American private trust concepts, forming a hybrid civil-law/trust vehicle
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 31 October 2012)
United Kingdom–Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 2009)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 27 April 2015 (AML/CFT framework) as amended; Executive Decree 54 of 2011 as amended by Executive Decrees 363 of 2015, 128 of 2020 and 152 of 2021; Law 25 of 12 June 1995 on Private Interest Foundations (minimum founding patrimony US$10,000); UAF Resolution No. 2 of 2021 on due diligence; beneficial ownership information is filed with the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) and maintained by the resident agent
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (centralized beneficial ownership data accessible only to the DGI, Unidad de Análisis Financiero, Public Registry, and criminal/asset-investigation authorities; not available to the public)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarially certified copy of the Founder's passport (all pages)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the Founder's country of residence or Consulate of Panama
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention member jurisdictions) OR Consular Legalization (non-member jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Foundation (Acta Constitutiva) and Foundation Regulations (Reglamento)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extract of foundation registration (inscripción in the Registro Público)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Foundation Council composition with UBO declaration annex
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Resident Agent (Agente Residente) of the foundation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the competent consulate of the receiving jurisdiction OR Hague Apostille where the receiving authority demands it

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record for each proposed Foundation Council member
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police/judicial criminal-record authority of the member's country of domicile

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Pre-incorporation written risk assessment classifying the foundation as Medium_Risk_Enhanced due to the air cargo charter brokerage scope. Mandatory screening of the Founder, all Foundation Council members, any Protector, and identified Beneficiaries against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI List, and Panamanian UAF designation lists under Law 23/2015 Articles 20–21 and Executive Decree 363/2015. PEP status must be self-certified and database-verified; PEP designation requires enhanced monitoring and, for this business profile, documented source of wealth covering the US$10,000 initial patrimony. Nominee council arrangements are prohibited for the licensed air cargo broker activity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Name Reservation Module (Sede Electrónica, http://www.registro.com.pa; Physical counter: Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas, Ancón, Panama City)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The name may be in Spanish or any Latin-alphabet language; 'Fundación' (or its foreign equivalent 'Foundation') must appear immediately before or after the chosen name (Law 25/1995). Non-Latin scripts require a sworn Spanish transliteration by a Panamanian public translator. Accents and numerals are preserved literally as reserved.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Financiera / Fondo de Pensiones (prior Superintendencia de Bancos approval required)
Seguros / Reaseguro (prior Superintendencia de Seguros approval required)
Cooperativa / Fideicomiso (sectoral license required before name clearance)
Fundación Pública / Fundación de Beneficencia (reserved for public-interest purposes)
Estado / Gobierno / Ministerio / Municipalidad (state-entity names prohibited)
Aerolínea / Línea Aérea / Carga Aérea / Charter Aéreo (prior Autoridad Aeronáutica Civil no-objection required for ISIC 5229 scope)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 25 of 12 June 1995 on Private Interest Foundations, as amended, Articles 1, 3, 9-13, 19-25, 30, 43
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado (Public Registry of Panama, Private Interest Foundations Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foundation Charter (Carta Fundacional) together with the Internal Regulations (Reglamento), executed as a notarized private document or public deed and presented for registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; the foundation capital must be determinable and sufficient to achieve the stated purpose; customary initial capital is US$100 and no escrow account is required under Law 25 of 1995
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 — THE FOUNDATION COUNCIL OF [FOUNDATION NAME], a Panama Private Interest Foundation under Law 25 of 1995, unanimously resolves: 1. Ratifying the Foundation Charter and internal Regulations. 2. Accepting the founder's initial capital contribution. 3. Adopting the registered office at the Resident Agent's Panama address. 4. Appointing ________ as President, ________ as Secretary, and ________ as Protector. 5. Ratifying [Resident Agency] as Resident Agent. 6. Authorizing the President to execute banking, civil aviation, industrial, and municipal filings for air cargo charter brokerage operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Portal de Servicios en Línea / Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name search (certificado de búsqueda de nombre) through the Registry's e-services portal; upon issuance of a certificate of no impediment, reserve the exclusive foundation name for a renewable 30-day term through the licensed Resident Agent.
required_dossiers: Public Registry name search application form
Power of attorney of the Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit up to two alternate names within ten business days of the Registry's query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarial Execution of Foundation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de Panamá (Public Notary of the Circuit of Panama)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Panama attorney to draft the Foundation Charter and the Internal Regulations specifying the foundation purpose of international air cargo charter brokerage, initial capital, beneficiaries, Foundation Council members, Protector and Resident Agent; execute the instrument before a Panamanian notary with the signatories' valid passports and notarized identities.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of the Foundation Council members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a defect, execute a notarized clarifying addendum before the instrument is submitted to the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the original notarized Foundation Charter and two certified copies, pay the registration and stamp fees, and obtain the entry of inscription together with the foundation's certificate of juridical personality.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect note, cure the requested clarification within fifteen days or appeal to the Directora General del Registro Público under the Registry's procedural rules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Certified Extracts and Formalizing Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá / Licensed Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the authenticated Certificado de Registro and certified copies of the foundation instrument, and formalize the Resident Agent's term and registered address for legal service of process.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Foundation Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Resident Agent acceptance is missing, obtain retroactive written consent and re-file the acceptance with the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / GEMA digital tax portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the foundation in the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) through the GEMA tax portal to obtain the Panamanian tax identification number required for banking, civil aviation licensing and municipal permitting; confirm territorial taxation treatment of foreign-source brokerage income.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the Foundation Council members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is withheld, satisfy the DGI verification request within ten working days; no taxable activity declarations are required until operations commence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License and Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá – Junta de Licencias e Inspección / competent municipality of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación and obtain the municipal business operating patent for the registered office; submit the office lease contract and undergo the municipal structural and electrical inspection if the office is open to clients; renew the patent annually.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney of the Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal inspection finds defects, remediate the safety or structural deficiencies and request re-inspection within thirty days; appeal any denial to the Municipal Licensing Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Aviation Cargo Agency and Charter Brokerage License Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autoridad de Aeronáutica Civil de Panamá (AAC) – Subdirección de Transporte Aéreo / Registro de Agentes de Carga
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the AAC application for the air cargo agency and charter brokerage operating permit with proof of the commercial office, financial standing, liability insurance and a nominated accountable manager; complete registration in the cargo agent registry and publish any tariffs required by civil aviation regulations.
required_dossiers: Identity and background documents of the accountable manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AAC requires supplemental confirmations, submit the requested documentation within twenty business days; a denial may be appealed to the AAC administrative law chamber and subsequently to the Sala Tercera of the Supreme Court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autoridad de Aeronáutica Civil de Panamá (AAC) – Subdirección de Transporte Aéreo
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Agencia de Carga Aérea y Permiso de Corretaje de Fletamento (Air Cargo Agency License and Charter Brokerage Permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Normativa e Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (low-impact registration / aviso de operación ambiental) for an administrative brokerage office; a Category II semi-detailed EIA is required if the foundation operates cargo handling, warehousing or aircraft ground-support facilities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater or volatile organic compound emissions are generated by pure office brokerage; if auxiliary warehousing or ground-support services are added, the operation must comply with MiAMBIENTE wastewater discharge tables, ambient air quality thresholds, and the national solid-waste handling regime, with non-hazardous waste removed by licensed collectors

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (Certificado de Requisitos de Seguridad, Prevención y Protección contra Incendios); structural and electrical load inspection by the municipal engineering office; workplace health and safety clearance under MITRADEL occupational hygiene rules and the Código de Trabajo

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), with its Sede Electrónica DGI electronic tax portal at https://dgi.mef.gob.pa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Private Interest Foundation (PIF) under Law 25 of 1995 is a Panamanian legal person and must: (1) be incorporated and registered at the Registro Público de Panamá through a Panama-licensed resident agent and a duly appointed foundation council; (2) file the Aviso de Operación with the DGI declaring the ISIC 5229 air cargo charter brokerage activity; (3) apply for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) through the Sede Electrónica DGI, submitting the foundation charter, resident agent acceptance, registered address, and foundation council documentation; (4) enroll simultaneously in the ITBMS (VAT) taxpayer registry and obtain electronic invoicing authorization from the DGI; (5) open a US Dollar bank account for receiving broker commissions via SWIFT Wire or Fedwire and file monthly ITBMS returns and the annual income tax return through the DGI portal. A foreign entity without a Panamanian fixed place of business is not required to register solely for offshore brokerage activities; if it operates through a permanent establishment in Panama, it must obtain its own RUC and register for ITBMS.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope; Entity_Level_Taxation: the PIF is a separate taxpayer subject to the 25% corporate income tax only upon Panamanian-source income. Foreign-source fees derived from cross-border air cargo charter brokerage remain outside the Panamanian tax base unless the income is sourced to Panama through local performance or a Panamanian permanent establishment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. Available statutory elections and regimes include: (1) the Régimen Especial Simplificado (simplified small-taxpayer tax method for annual gross income below USD 300,000); (2) the Sede de Empresa Multinacional (SEM) election under Law 41 of 2007 for qualified multinational headquarters operations; (3) advance pricing agreements with the DGI for transfer pricing certainty; and (4) for hybrid mismatch exposure, the CFC, economic substance, and transparency rules introduced by Panama Law 254 of 2019. A PIF cannot elect pass-through status, but non-Panamanian-source income is excluded from the taxable base under territoriality.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — Panamanian VAT/GST
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no monetary turnover threshold triggering registration: every person habitually performing taxable acts in Panama must register for ITBMS and obtain an RUC. A USD 300,000 annual gross income ceiling is only the eligibility boundary for the optional simplified small-taxpayer regime, not a registration exemption.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates real-time fiscal clearance: all active RUC holders must issue electronic invoices through DGI-certified integrators, transmit invoice data via API (REST/SOAP) to the Sede Electrónica DGI for pre-validation, obtain a DGI digital stamp and QR verification code, and deliver the cleared document to the buyer. Paper or PDF invoices are admissible only under certified DGI contingency procedures; invoices issued without DGI clearance are invalid and cannot support ITBMS input credits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for the 0% ITBMS export rate where they physically leave Panama under a customs export declaration (DUA) in the exporter's RUC, are destined to a foreign market, and are paid from abroad. Services, including air cargo charter brokerage commissions, qualify where the service is supplied to a non-resident counterparty, is not effectively used or consumed in Panama, confers its benefit outside Panama, and the fee is received from a foreign bank. Eligible zero-rated exporters may also recover attributable input ITBMS credits.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Certified copy of the ANA Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera, DUA)
Original Air Waybill (AWB) or Bill of Lading evidencing cargo uplift and foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of USD proceeds from the foreign counterparty via SWIFT Wire or Fedwire
Executed export service contract and the DGI-approved 0% ITBMS export invoice
Foundation council statement certifying that the brokerage service is consumed outside Panama and that no Panamanian recipient exists
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may audit and reassess within the general six-year prescription period. If export zero-rating is unsupported, fraudulent, or not repatriated within 180 days, the DGI retroactively claws back the 7% ITBMS from the invoice date with monthly statutory interest, imposes fines of 25% to 100% of the omitted tax, excludes the taxpayer from the 0% export procedure register, cancels the Aviso de Operación, and may pursue criminal tax fraud charges carrying two to five years' imprisonment and fines up to USD 200,000 for wilful evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama operates without an independent central bank; the U.S. dollar is legal tender. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama (SBP) is the primary banking and foreign-exchange-related regulator, while Banco Nacional de Panama acts as the fiscal agent of the State with no monetary authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility exists on both capital and current account transactions. There are no exchange control laws, no currency exchange license requirements, and no centralized foreign exchange market. Dividends, profit remittances, loan repayments, equity capital returns, and service payments to non-residents may be freely effected in U.S. dollars. The only practical constraints are bank-level AML/KYC requirements, source-of-funds verification, tax attestations, and evidence of the underlying cargo charter brokerage transaction for unusual or large wire flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory timeline for surrendering export proceeds and no mandatory conversion ratio for foreign currency receipts. Air cargo charter brokerage income may remain in U.S. dollars in any authorized bank account, be used directly for outbound disbursements, or be repatriated without prior approval from any Panamanian authority.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with material legal constraints. Panama recognizes fintech operators under Law 125 of 2020, but there is no standalone e-money institution (EMI) license identical to the EU or UK regimes. Offshore digital EMI platforms may be utilized for outbound trade disbursements and collection of cross-border charter brokerage fees only when the EMI settles through an SBP-licensed bank or a U.S./international correspondent bank acceptable to the Panamanian banking system. Such EMIs are not a substitute for an onshore Panama account for capital injection and are not treated as regulated deposit-taking institutions. The viability rating is Medium: permissible for treasury optimization and cross-border disbursement speed, but the PM/PIF must maintain a primary onshore account with a licensed Panamanian bank and ensure that all EMIs are subject to sanctions screening, AML monitoring, and transaction traceability.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for initial onboarding of a newly established PIF engaged in air cargo charter broking. At least one foundation council member and the registered agent's compliance officer must attend an in-person interview at a tier-1 Panamanian bank branch. Remote opening via videoconference is occasionally permitted for existing premium clients with a verified relationship, but for a new PIF entity with offshore beneficiaries and aircraft charter-related payment flows, the de facto policy is face-to-face completion of enhanced due diligence, biometric verification, and signing of the foundation's banking mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PIF beneficial ownership opacity and ambiguous interest structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled foundation deed, articles of incorporation, registered agent certificate, foundation council resolution appointing the cargo charter broker manager, updated beneficial ownership register filed in accordance with Law 23 of 2015 and Decree 41 of 2018, valid passports and other national identity documents of all natural-person beneficial owners, and a notarized source-of-wealth declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk air cargo charter contracts with payments to offshore, tax-haven, or non-transparent counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed charter agreements with verified counterparties, commercial and pro forma invoices, aircraft registration documents (Panama Aircraft Registry where applicable), air waybills (AWB) and cargo manifests, commission calculation summaries, correspondence trail showing commercial negotiation, and a written AML risk assessment of each high-risk counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusually large inbound contributions or funding from unrelated offshore jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds bank statements, PIF board resolution authorizing the capital injection, executed loan or contribution agreements, SWIFT payment evidence, capital account ledger entries in the PIF's accounting records, and a professional legal opinion confirming the transaction is consistent with the foundation's registered purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: OFAC, sanctions, and PEP exposure through cargo routes or client jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions and PEP screening results, OFAC SDN list checks, denied-party screening logs, IP and geolocation evidence for digital transactions, beneficial owner identification of all material counterparties, contractual sanctions and embargo representations, and a compliance certificate issued by the PIF's designated AML officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Co-mingling of personal, foundation, and sub-broker funds within the same account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintenance of segregated accounts in the sole name of the PIF, board-approved banking mandate containing an anti-mingling policy, detailed accounting ledgers by client and charter contract, annual audited financial statements (even where not statutorily required), and a transaction-monitoring procedure identifying expected activity volumes for the air cargo brokerage business.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections are structured through SWIFT MT103 or Fedwire transfers from the beneficial owner, a related finance company, or an investor account to the PIF's designated U.S.-dollar account in Panama. The wire must clearly state the beneficiary: 'Private Interest Foundation PA_PIF', the beneficiary bank in Panama, the full account number, and a purpose narrative such as 'Capital Contribution to PIF PA_PIF under Foundation Deed dated [date]' or 'Intercompany Loan to PIF PA_PIF for Working Capital'. The remitting bank must transmit the complete ordering customer chain (name, address, account number) and, when required, the sourcing financial institution. The receiving Panamanian bank will require the PIF's registered agent certificate, foundation deed excerpt, and supporting board resolution; inclusion of the commercial invoice, capital account entry, and good-standing certificate reduces clearing delays. For contributions in EUR, GBP, CNY, or other non-USD currencies, the remittance may be credited to a multicurrency account or spot-converted by the receiving licensed bank; conversion must be evidenced by a trade confirmation and recorded in the PIF's books.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are cleared using: (1) SWIFT MT103 for high-value USD/EUR/GBP payments to charter operators, fuel supplliers, airport authorities, sub-brokers, and aircraft maintenance providers; (2) SWIFT MT202 COV for downstream interbank cover payments executed by the intermediary bank; (3) Fedwire for same-day clearing requiring US-dollar finality to domestic U.S. beneficiaries; (4) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600/ISBP) issued through SWIFT MT700/MT710 for aircraft charter and cargo-service purchase obligations; (5) Documentary collections (DP/DA) through the correspondent banking network for less liquid freight jurisdictions; and (6) ACH Panama for low-value domestic U.S.-dollar payments to Panamanian vendors. Each disbursement must reference the underlying charter agreement, carrier commission invoice, and air waybill; no exchange-control approval is required, but the PIF must preserve the full transaction trail for bank audit and OFAC/SIU review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward contracts with licensed Panamanian and international banks matching EUR/GBP/CNY charter brokerage receivables and payables, with tenors of up to 24 months
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD for emerging-market currencies where physical delivery is restricted or illiquid, including fuel and routing corridor exposures
Cross-currency swaps (USD vs EUR/GBP/CNY) executed under an ISDA Master Agreement to hedge structural foreign-currency cash-flow mismatches
Plain vanilla FX call and put options and zero-cost collars for protection against adverse exchange-rate movements on large lease payments and aircraft charter fees
FX forward roll-over facilities and netting arrangements provided by the PIF's primary relationship bank, subject to credit approval and ISDA documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PIF Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Anual de Fundación de Interés Privado)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, paid via Banco Nacional de Panamá; linked to Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed calendar deadline; due on or before June 30 of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment adds a USD 300 surcharge (total USD 600); Certificate of Good Standing is withheld; three consecutive unpaid years trigger registry classification as inactive and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Sworn Confirmation (Declaración Jurada del Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) / Registro Público de Panamá - Beneficial Owner Registry (Law 18 of 2023; Executive Decree 187 of 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due on or before June 30; any change in beneficial ownership must also be declared within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines against the resident agent and foundation officers under AML/CFT law (up to USD 10,000); registry certifications suspended; unverified foundations face strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Formulario 2000 - Declaración Jurada Anual de Renta) if economic activity is conducted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year filers must file on or before March 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly default interest accrues on unpaid tax from the due date; late-filing fines and surcharges apply; sustained non-filing enables tax liens and suspension of tax ID (RUC).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Air Cargo Agency Permit / Freight Forwarder Authorization
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Autoridad de Aeronáutica Civil (AAC) de Panamá - Dirección de Seguridad Aérea / Transporte Aéreo
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar renewal; application and fee due on or before December 31 of each year per AAC fee schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal suspends the cargo agency certificate and blocks cargo booking and consolidation operations; operating without a valid permit is an administrative breach subject to AAC fines and permit revocation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Standard PIFs are exempt from mandatory external audit. A certified independent audit is compulsory only if (i) the Foundation Statutes expressly require it, or (ii) the foundation conducts commercial activity and annual gross revenue equals or exceeds B/. 3,000,000, in which case audited financial statements by a licensed Panamanian CPA must be filed with the DGI (Panama Tax Code Art. 858, Law 66 of 2017).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as published by the IASB; eligible small entities and dormant PIFs may apply IFRS for SMEs; non-trading PIFs satisfy requirements by maintaining the statutory registry books (beneficiaries, assets, contributions and disbursements).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At incorporation and annually thereafter, the resident agent must perform KYC/CDD, record each final beneficial owner, and file the sworn annual UBO confirmation through the Beneficial Owner Registry (Law 18 of 2023; Executive Decree 187 of 2025). Any transfer or change in the beneficiary structure requires updating the register with notarized supporting documentation within 30 days; the annual confirmation cycle closes each June 30.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Assets and Liabilities (Registro de Bienes)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 - USD 1,500 per year (Panama resident agent and registered office services, exclusive of government fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 4,000 per year (full certified audit only when statutes or the B/. 3,000,000 revenue threshold apply; non-trading PIFs typically incur no audit fee)

stage_6.entry_description: Tax identification number assigned by DGI to the PIF
stage_6.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PIF must obtain RUC through its resident agent before filing; include the 10-digit RUC and domicile code.
